attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **There is no `dates` object on purpose**: the page closes his life with «Κοιμήθηκε το 580 μ.Χ., ενώ κατ' άλλους το 681 μ.Χ.», two years a century and a hundred and one apart, and a year the source itself will not choose is not a recorded one. The entry carries no asterisk. Nothing in the corpus answers to the name. No hymn.
